text.en: The sitio of Balogo in the barrio of Calatrava, Municipality of San Agustin, Province of Romblon, is separated from said barrio and constituted into a distinct and independent barrio of said municipality to be known as the barrio of Balogo.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: May 7, 1959.
